The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. As the final output, report the total energy of the relaxed structure in electronvolts (eV), and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.

Required submission format:
{"BULK ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"BULK ENERGY": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structure/structure.dat"}
